main_body: Leafy tree canopy (green foliage mass) on a thin brown trunk with a grass patch base
top_band: Canopy top: light-to-mid green clumps rows ~1-12 with lit upper surface; organic mass, no hard horizontal band
evidence: Organic tree: the canopy is a rounded volume with lit upper clumps and darker underside foliage with a shadowed lower edge above the trunk. The trunk reads as a vertical form on a grass patch. There is no rigid top/front geometry, and the lit-from-above canopy with darker lower foliage fits the 3/4 read for an organic piece. No receding side face and no flat elevation.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 5 green steps (deep dark green, dark, mid, light, highlight) with clumped leaf shapes and a dark-green outline tinted by the foliage rather than black. The trunk has a 3-4 step ramp from light tan-brown to dark maroon with a shaded right side. The grass base uses 2-3 greens. Leaf clumping is less defined than in the references, which show individual leaf clusters with bright highlights and visible branches. The trunk is a plain narrow column with no roots or flare, and the grass patch is flat. Overall the piece sits close to the reference but is slightly thinner in the trunk and base.
